//: Used only by .dependency-cruiser.js. Two reasons it is not any service's
own tsconfig: dependency-cruiser resolves 'extends' relative to the cwd,
not to the config file, so an extending config fails to load; and without
these path mappings every @ip/* import resolves through the workspace
symlink to services/<name>/dist/index.d.ts, which the cruiser's own
exclude pattern then drops — making the cross-service rule silently inert.
Mapping to src/index.ts puts the real source path in the graph, which is
what the boundary rule matches on.
